race.comment: LEFT HOOK (9) just found one better here last time in a similar race, running on strongly to be beaten a length. Sets up to sit handy this time from the inside gate and won't need to do any more to be taking care of these. ASKMUMASKDAD (8) is coming off a maiden win at Pakenham Synthetic, scoring by 1.3 lengths at the 14th time of asking. Whether he can string two together remains to be seen but this is a good option in a thin race. TWO SIGMA (6) is coming off a BM56 win at Wodonga but was a mile off LEFT HOOK when they clashed prior. Didn't fire that day but could be an improver. UP AND UNDER (7) is off a let-up, and back in trip. The run two back over a mile has him in the mix. KOROBEINIKI (5) doesn't win out of turn but has rough claims.
